topic: Driving off on a spot delivery yo yo financing contract vs waiting for final lender approval (Ross vs Adele)

scenes.narration: Dealers can legally take your new car back weeks later. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera at the bench, giant comic banner reads THEY TOOK IT BACK, a car key and a torn contract in the spotlight, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ross and Adele both drive home the same used SUV Friday.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man ross and woman adele driving identical used SUVs off a dealer lot with a sign reading SOLD, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both signed papers marked delivery pending final lender approval.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, close up of two contracts stamped PENDING FINAL APPROVAL in bold red letters, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ross skips the fine print and celebrates his four hundred payment.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man ross celebrating beside his SUV holding a paper reading FOUR HUNDRED A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ten days later the dealer calls, the financing fell through.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man ross on the phone looking stunned, a comic speech banner reads FINANCING FELL THROUGH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: They demand he resign at eleven percent or return it.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a salesman sliding a new contract reading ELEVEN PERCENT across a desk toward worried man ross, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Adele read that clause and refused to drive off Friday.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman adele pointing at a pending approval clause and handing the keys back at the dealership counter, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She waited for signed lender approval before taking any keys.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman adele holding a paper stamped LENDER APPROVED at a bank desk, smiling, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ross now pays three thousand more in interest over five years.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man ross slumped beside a meter reading THREE THOUSAND EXTRA INTEREST, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Adele financed through her credit union at six percent flat.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman adele at a credit union desk under a banner reading SIX PERCENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Same SUV, same week, two very different five year contracts.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two identical SUVs side by side with price tags reading ELEVEN PERCENT and SIX PERCENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Never drive off before financing is final. Get approval in writing. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel holding a contract stamped FINAL APPROVAL IN WRITING, comic burst banner reads NOT FINAL NOT YOURS, kids comic book illustration
